name: com.spendcanary/free-tools
title: SpendCanary free Google Ads tools
description: Free Google Ads tools: ad copy, ROAS, CPC, budgets, wasted spend, landing pages and Reddit trends.

tools.name: check_ad_copy
tools.description: Checks Google responsive search ad or Meta ad text against character limits and common rejection reasons (symbols, capitals, repeated text, claims). Returns issues per line: fix (likely rejected or cut off) or look (worth a second look).

platform.description: google for a responsive search ad, meta for a Facebook or Instagram ad

headlines.description: Google: up to 15 headlines. Meta: headlines.

descriptions.description: Google: up to 4 descriptions. Meta: descriptions.

keyword.description: The main keyword or service the ad is for.

tools.name: daily_budget_max_spend
tools.description: The most Google Ads can charge in one day (2× the average daily budget) and in a month (30.4×) for a campaign daily budget.

daily_budget.description: Average daily budget of one campaign.

currency.description: Currency code for the amounts; amounts are shown in it, never converted.

tools.name: roas
tools.description: Return on ad spend from sales and ad spend, plus the break-even ROAS and profit for a profit margin.

revenue.description: Sales from the ads (conversion value) in the period.

ad_spend.description: What the ads cost in the same period.

margin_percent.description: Profit margin in percent, for the break-even ROAS.

currency.description: Currency code for the amounts; amounts are shown in it, never converted.

tools.name: cpc
tools.description: Cost per click from spend and clicks, or clicks from spend and cost per click (any two of the three), plus CPM and click-through rate from impressions.

cost_per_click.description: Cost per click; give two of spend, clicks and cost_per_click.

impressions.description: Impressions, for CPM and click-through rate.

currency.description: Currency code for the amounts; amounts are shown in it, never converted.

tools.name: google_ads_budget
tools.description: Monthly and daily Google Ads budget from a lead (or sales) goal: leads ÷ conversion rate = clicks, × cost per click = monthly budget, ÷ 30.4 = daily budget. Also the most Google can charge for that daily budget (2× a day, 30.4× a month) and a warning when it buys fewer than about 10 clicks a day.

leads_per_month.description: Leads (or sales) wanted from the ads each month.

conversion_rate_percent.description: Expected share of clicks that become a lead or sale, in percent (5 means 5%).

cost_per_lead.description: Cost per lead or sale, if known; it sets the budget instead of cost_per_click ÷ conversion rate.

currency.description: Currency code for the amounts; amounts are shown in it, never converted.

tools.name: search_partners_cost
tools.description: Compares cost per conversion on Google Search with the Search Partners network and estimates what partners cost a month beyond Search, using the same rule as the SpendCanary scan.

currency.description: Currency code for the amounts; amounts are shown in it, never converted.

tools.name: wasted_spend_from_search_terms
tools.description: Reads a Google Ads search terms report (CSV text) and totals the spend on search terms with no conversions, with the costliest ones and a monthly figure.

csv.description: The Google Ads search terms report exported as CSV, as text (up to 2 MB).

tools.name: check_landing_page
tools.description: Loads a public landing page on a phone and a computer and checks speed, redirects, a way to call, book or buy, and the Google tag. Limited to 5 checks an hour.

url.description: The public web address an ad sends people to.

tools.name: google_ads_problem_trends
tools.description: How often each Google Ads wasted spend problem (junk searches, search partners, overspending, click fraud, location targeting, Google changing the account, PMax brand spend) comes up in public Reddit posts: the last 12 weeks, or monthly per 1,000 posts since January 2025. From SpendCanary's daily count; mentions, not a sample of advertisers.

topic.description: One problem, or all: wasted_spend, irrelevant_terms (broad match and junk searches), partners_display (search partners and Display), overspend, click_fraud, location, auto_changes (Google changing the account), pmax_brand.

period.description: weeks: the last 12 weeks. months: monthly rate per 1,000 posts since January 2025.
